a.lede: Huawei and Qualcomm sign a multi-year patent cross-license covering 5G and AI, with Qualcomm buying some Huawei US patents.
a.title: Qualcomm will pay Huawei to license its patents for the first time in historic turnaround

b.lede: Qualcomm will license patents behind Huawei’s LogicFolding, according to one report, as a teardown shows off the Kirin 9050 Pro’s two dies.
b.title: Qualcomm will license patents behind Huawei’s LogicFolding chip architecture, report says
